decisions.reason: The foldable large container line sits in the core reusable packaging business and uses existing tooling, so holding the option costs little even though its visibility since 2019 is unknown.
Stackable crates are cheap extensions of established moulds, and the lack of recent website evidence is not enough to justify giving up the option.
The rackable pallet line serves existing pallet and pooling customers at low marginal cost, and there is no clear negative signal that its value will not be realized.
The spill-retention pallet fills a niche industrial safety need with low holding cost, so keeping it open preserves upside while uptake is still uncertain.
The pallet with load retainers is a low-cost specialised variant, and without results showing failure, dropping it would give up option value for little saving.
